signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Aggressive receivers overpower defenders and attack the football. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their success rate on aggressive catches against single coverage.
After securing a RAC catch, ballcarriers with this ability can quickly shift momentum, change direction, and turn the corner without sacrificing speed.
When lined up as a tight end; players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes during pre-play adjustments; and react more promptly to playmaker inputs.
Receivers with this ability have a high success rate when creating separation on the last cut of any route.
Ballcarriers with this ability will break almost any hit-stick tackle attempts made on them.
Blockers with this ability reduce an edge pass rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move
Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move.
Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move while pass blocking.
Players with this ability can detect user-controlled defenders before the snap; as well as 3rd and 4th down blitzers. Can be bluffed.
Defenders with this ability are rarely faked out by ballcarrier moves (and cannot be faked out when user-controlled).
Defenders with this ability have higher chance to catch uncontested interceptions, and they have unlimited stamina on the return (until using a special move or breaking a tackle).
Defenders with this ability will cause increased fatigue penalties when tackling a ballcarrier with a non-conservative tackle.
Defenders with this ability generally react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage and outside the numbers
Players with this ability are much less likely to be fooled by WR runoffs
Defenders with this ability generally react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage and inside the numbers
Ballcarriers with this ability retain more of their forward momentum during tackles while travelling at high speeds.
Players with this ability are harder to knock out of The Zone
Players with this ability will recover from the effects of fatigue at an increased rate between plays.
Blockers with this ability start every new blocking encounter with built-in resistance
Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move while pass blocking.
Defenders with this ability are highly likely to force catch knockouts against running backs.
Defenders with this ability are granted a free pass rush move once per play after spending a pass rush point
Defenders with this ability will cause increased fatigue penalties when tackling a ballcarrier with a non-conservative tackle.
Defenders with this ability can reach out of engaged blocks to tackle or sack nearby ballcarriers.
Defenders with this ability force more catch tackle knockouts in man-to-man versus medium routes, 10-20 yards from the LoS.
Effective D-Line captains aren't just examples to follow, they are motivators. When they enter the zone, all opposing blockers have their resistance bars wiped out.
Defenders with this ability use faster, more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the edge of the defense.
Defenders with this ability will win pass blocks when they correctly use the Guess Play adjustment to predict a pass. Incorrect guesses will result in a loss.
Pass rushers with this ability must spend double the pass rush points to perform a move but are granted dominant wins
Defenders with this ability can apply pressure to the quarterback from a greater distance.
Shutdown defenders have the talent to erase receivers from the game. When they enter the zone, their coverage is tighter and interceptions are more frequent on contested catches.
Defenders with this ability generally react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage
Defenders with this ability force more catch tackle knockouts in man-to-man versus medium routes, 10-20 yards from the LoS.
Defenders with this ability force more catch tackle knockouts in man-to-man versus short routes less than 10 yards from LoS
Defenders with this ability generally react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage and outside the numbers

signatureAbility.signatureActivationDescription: Make consecutive passes for 5+ yards in air
signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Elite quarterbacks are molded by endless hours of film study. When they enter the zone, they have full vision of the secondary's defensive coverage before the snap.
Passers with this ability have faster passing animations when they are throwing under pressure
Passers with this ability are immune to throw penalties caused by defensive pressure while on the run
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all throws inside the numbers (except on high/low throws).
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all throws outside the numbers (except on high/low throws).
Passers with this ability have increased throw power on bullet precision passes (except on high/low throws).
